subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding what a check is and how it's used to pay for something without cash
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines a sample check and identifies each labeled part (date, payee, amount, signature)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a part of a check to what information goes there
exercise.abstract: Student explains what a check is and how using one differs from paying with cash

misconception_flags: confuses which field on a check holds which piece of information

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
